record_type_quote: The models have been implemented using code and information provided by the authors.

targets.authors: Hudson, Drew A., and Zitnick, C. Lawrence
targets.title: Generative Adversarial Transformers
targets.evidence_quote: In this project, we have discussed the replication of “Generative adversarial Transformers” by Hudson and Zitnick [2].
targets.outcome_computational_quote: As mentioned before, unexpectedly, the model that yields better results in the original paper is not the best in our experiments. Not only the FID score is worse than the baseline StyleGAN2 at the final training step, both for simplex and duplex attention implementations, but also claims about efficiency cannot be verified.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: In this study, we have first implemented a Google Colab Pro compatible version of the authors’ code, enabling us to train and test StyleGAN2 and the two flavours of GANformer (Duplex and Simplex attention) in less than 54 hours in total. As presented in Section 5, we could not achieve the improvements declared by the authors but instead found a decrease in time performance and quality using duplex attention.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original code and the original FFHQ data are rerun with shorter training, reduced images, and architecture/hyperparameter variations. Comparable numbers are obtained but the original superiority is not recovered. Their final statement that the model was successfully reproduced concerns implementation, not recovery of the original numbers. FFHQ results independently challenge performance under alternative training and architecture choices; Cartoon-only findings are not used as robustness evidence.

No DOI is printed in the original reference. Training constraints reduce the conclusiveness of the substantive challenge but do not prevent comparable numerical output.
